old_problem: Items specifies two motherboard PSU inlet resources, while the private Script path implies PSU1-4 and Procedure uses a broad family filter. No authoritative script copy exists in the workspace. Member count, physical inlet locations, populated/absent behavior and whether the script name denotes four inlet sensors or merely a reusable family cannot be derived from standard IPMI. A plausible temperature from a different PSU/internal component could otherwise mask missing inlet coverage.
disposition_reason: Retain Engineering Decision Pending and Source Conflict because a signed project scope or reviewed private-script revision is required to choose two versus four physical inlet resources. ED-03/ED-13 and standard ipmitool semantics resolve the safe collection method, while the user's parameterization rule allows target, thresholds and exact IDs to be runtime Project inputs. They do not authorize selecting one conflicting cardinality. The row is not BLOCKED: after owner binding, complete read-only IB/OOB SDR/Sensor and real BMC Web visual evidence can be collected without PSU, thermal or log mutation.
decision_basis: The exact XLSX row 1720, same-row DeepSeek/test-json content, GPT V2, historical V3.1 record, pending/conflict analyses, duplicate identity result, local authoritative-script search and ED-01 through ED-30 rules were read. The actual next formal queue identity was reconstructed and directly opened as Functionality row 1721 / Wistron-BMC-00993-V005 / 0a00b0d5a1baa2a0.

Items' `1~2` is an apparent member range, not a valid guarantee that a literal sensor named `TEMP_MB_PSU1~2_IN` exists. Conversely, the private path suffix `1-4` is not enough to prove four authoritative inlet sensors without its reviewed content and platform map.

Motherboard inlet temperature is a physical airflow-location measurement and need not be identical to internal PSU telemetry. Each accepted resource must bind to a signed board/PSU inlet location, PSU population and airflow direction rather than name similarity.

The source requires five evidence planes: IB SDR, OOB SDR, IB Sensor, OOB Sensor and BMC Web. Full raw lists and page context must be retained; broad grep can aid discovery only and DeepSeek's literal query/head truncation cannot establish completeness.

Exact temperature limits, units, scaling, freshness and load/ambient tolerance require the Project thermal SPEC under ED-18. Missing runtime values may be parameterized but no threshold is invented and no PASS is possible without them.
ED-10/ED-21 preserve genuine WebUI evidence, ED-19 prohibits clearing diagnostic history, and ED-26 prohibits retrying to hide stale/divergent readings. The collection remains read-only.
No protected source, private script, PSU, BMC, thermal control, log or DUT was modified or executed.

test_case.test_name: TEMP_MB_PSU inlet sensors — owner-resolved member set across five read-only views
test_case.purpose: After the owner defines the authoritative two- or four-member inlet set, verify every physical motherboard/PSU inlet resource consistently across IB/OOB SDR, IB/OOB Sensor List and the same-target BMC Web Sensor page against the signed thermal/location matrix.
required_package: Written owner ruling for `TEMP_MB_PSU1~2_IN` versus private `temp_psu1-4`, including reviewed script revision if authoritative and exact member list/count
Verified SUT/BMC/firmware and same-target IB/OOB/Web identity plus PSU population, board inlet-location, adjacent PSU/feed and airflow map
Signed sensor matrix for canonical IDs/names/descriptions, units/scaling, expected value/range/status/thresholds, freshness, absent/populated rules and time/load/ambient tolerance
Supported secret-safe ipmitool IB/OOB collectors with complete untruncated SDR/Sensor output, normalizer/comparator and immutable evidence storage
Protected TLS-validated BMC Web access, authorized visual reviewer, page/filter/pagination/refresh context and timestamped screenshots/exports
test_case.test_command: After scope binding, verify one target and record PSU population/load/airflow/ambient context. Capture and hash complete IB `ipmitool sdr elist`, OOB `sdr elist`, IB `sensor list` and OOB `sensor list` outputs, then visually capture every authoritative inlet row/detail from the same BMC Web Sensor page with page/filter/pagination/refresh context. Normalize identity, location, name, description, reading, unit, status, thresholds and freshness across all five views and compare to the signed matrix. Use family filtering only after complete capture; do not query the range expression as one literal sensor, truncate output, clear logs or mutate PSU/thermal state.
test_case.expected_result: Every owner-approved inlet location appears exactly once in all applicable views, maps to the correct physical board/PSU/airflow location and agrees on identity, description, unit/scaling, status, threshold and fresh reading within the signed time/load/ambient tolerance. Required absent/populated semantics are satisfied, no unexpected member substitutes for an inlet, and the read-only collection changes no SDR, PSU, fan, power, threshold, BMC or log state.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: Review remains PENDING until the member-count/location ruling is signed. After binding, PASS requires complete five-view, per-location conformance to the approved matrix; command success, a broad grep match, one literal range-name result, plausible temperature, partial SDR or Web screenshot without context is insufficient. Missing/extra/duplicate/stale/unmapped resources, wrong location/units/status/threshold/value or cross-view divergence is reported for engineer FAIL/BLOCKED disposition. No threshold or member count is inferred, and the end user decides the verdict.
safety_gate: Do not silently choose two or four members or equate motherboard inlet and internal PSU telemetry; stop interpretation when scope/location mapping is unsigned.
Keep all paths read-only: do not add/delete/clear SDR, reset or power-cycle PSU, change fan/threshold/thermal/power/BMC settings or clear logs.
Verify exact same-target IB/OOB/Web identity, protect credentials/tokens and reject cross-host, stale, cached, truncated or paginated-away evidence.
Do not invent temperature limits, unit conversions, absent-state policy, freshness or tolerance; use only the signed Project thermal matrix.
Preserve first mismatched evidence and do not automatically refresh/retry to obtain agreement.
expected_evidence: Exact Source Key/Variant, written member-scope ruling, reviewed script revision if used and authoritative member list
Target/firmware identity, same-target proof, PSU population/load/ambient/airflow and physical inlet-location map
Complete hashed raw IB/OOB SDR and Sensor lists plus normalized per-resource fields and collection timestamps
Timestamped BMC Web page/detail captures with target, filter, pagination and refresh context for every member
Five-view matrix comparison, preserved-log/no-mutation/no-retry audit, exceptions and engineer-owned PENDING/PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED verdict
test_case.recovery: No functional recovery is expected from approved reads. On scope, target, access, parsing, freshness, mapping or five-view mismatch, stop interpretation, preserve raw/UI context and close sessions; do not clear, refresh repeatedly, reset PSU/BMC, change thermal controls or manipulate hardware. If an unintended write occurs, invoke only the pre-approved owner procedure for that exact state and escalate.

source_conflict.reason: Items names PSU1~2 inlet sensors, while the private script path implies PSU1-4 and the broad Procedure filter proves neither cardinality nor physical identity. Only project/script authority can resolve the required member set.

blocked.reason: The standard read-only collection, UI evidence, safety boundary and recovery are defined. Member set, physical map and thresholds are obtainable Project inputs; inability to obtain them at execution time may yield BLOCKED but does not make the review method undefined.

pending.remaining_project_configuration: Written two-versus-four scope ruling; reviewed private-script revision if authoritative; exact resource names/count; physical inlet/PSU/airflow map and population rules; target/firmware/same-target paths; thermal limits/units/freshness/load/ambient tolerance; Web route/context and evidence destination.
pending.execution_status: REVIEW COMPLETE BUT ENGINEERING DECISION PENDING; EXECUTION NOT STARTED; NO SENSOR/SDR/PSU/FAN/THERMAL/LOG, BMC/DUT OR OTHER HARDWARE ACTION AUTHORIZED OR EXECUTED

external_authorities.application: Supports standard SDR and sensor read command families used for non-destructive collection; it does not define OEM/project inlet membership, physical location or acceptance thresholds.

project_authority: The platform/thermal owner resolves two versus four members, supplies the physical inlet map, PSU population semantics and signed thermal matrix, and approves the private script revision if used. The BMC owner supplies canonical SDR/Sensor/Web field mapping; an authorized reviewer preserves genuine WebUI evidence; the end user decides verdict.
